about.overview: Hotel Grand Central Limited expanded its hotel and commercial property interest into Australia and New Zealand in the early 1990s, purchasing commercial property in Sydney, Australia and Wellington, New Zealand. Further expansion occurred again with the purchase of several hotel properties in Australia and New Zealand in 1995. At this point, Grand Central Management Limited was established to manage the various hotel and commercial property interests.

issues.title: Not mobile-friendly
issues.evidence: The page has no responsive viewport tag, so phones show a shrunken desktop layout.

issues.title: Not served over HTTPS
issues.evidence: Final URL is http://www.ghihotels.com/hgc/index.aspx. Browsers label this site "Not secure".

issues.title: Built with legacy page techniques
issues.evidence: 2 deprecated tags and 4 layout tables found (modern sites use responsive CSS).

issues.title: No search description
issues.evidence: No meta description, so Google chooses random page text for search results.

issues.title: No local-business search markup
issues.evidence: No structured data, so Google has less to show for the business.
